Core Strategy
Strategy & Practical Adoption

Powering Our Daily Work (Without Disruption)

Rather than altering how DAS Bahrain operates today, our plan is to connect a secure cloud database and backend admin portal to our live website—making everyday order handling faster, easier, and error-free.
🌐 Our Live Storefront
Already showcases Alsi Cola, energy drinks, and food items with carton/unit toggles and BenefitPay. It gives customers a credible direct channel.
☁️ The Missing Link: Cloud Database
By connecting a lightweight cloud database (hosted securely on Google Cloud/AWS), every order, inquiry, and customer contact is saved instantly and securely.
🖥️ Backend Admin Portal (/admin)
A password-protected screen where our staff manages orders, edits stock, and updates prices in seconds from any laptop or mobile phone.
📈 Marketing & Phased Growth
Once our team is comfortable using the backend daily, we can roll out customer tracking, cold store wholesale logins, and van tools as we expand.
💡
Guiding Principle
Zero disruption to our current sales routine. We start by using the website as a practical daily tool for our staff, then expand features as our order volume grows.

Two-Sided Platform
Architecture
System Overview

The Customer Storefront + The Employee Portal

One unified platform powered by a secure cloud database, serving both our buyers and our office team.
🛒 1. Customer-Facing Storefront
Who uses it: Retail shoppers, families, offices, and cold stores.
What they do:
  • Browse full beverage & grocery catalogue.
  • Select single cans or wholesale cartons.
  • Place orders via BenefitPay QR & WhatsApp.
  • Submit B2B wholesale inquiries across Bahrain.
🔐 2. Backend Employee Portal (/admin)
Who uses it: DAS sales team, dispatchers, and management.
What they do:
  • See incoming orders in one organized live list.
  • Update carton prices and mark items out-of-stock.
  • Access customer phone numbers and delivery addresses.
  • Export customer contacts for marketing and broadcasts.

Fleet & Operational Peace
Phase 3 & 4
Expansion Step 3 & 4 • Van Delivery & Compliance

Van Delivery Checklist & Daily Cash Check

Tools introduced as van routes expand, ensuring zero lost stock and seamless compliance.
📱 Driver Phone Checklist (/driver)
Van drivers open a simple mobile page on their phone showing today's 10–15 delivery stops with store names, crate counts, and 1-tap phone calls.
💰 6:00 PM Stock & Cash Tally
Morning crates loaded vs. evening returns = verified crates sold. Cash collected + BenefitPay receipts must match 100% before drivers leave.
🪪 LMRA & Visa Expiry Warnings
Automatic 60-day alerts for driver CPR, driving licenses, and work permits—protecting DAS Bahrain from government fines.
🏦 1-Click WPS Bank Salary File
Generates the exact SIF payroll file required by Bahrain banks (NBB, BBK, Ila, AUB) for monthly Wages Protection System compliance.
🛡️
Why this protects our margins
Eliminates lost delivery notes, prevents missing inventory, and ensures all cash is deposited safely at the end of each shift.

Roadmap & Next Step
Roadmap Summary
A Grounded, Phased Rollout

How We Move Forward at Our Own Pace

A simple 3-step path to start benefiting from the platform today without taking on unnecessary risks.
1️⃣ Step 1: Connect Cloud Database
Set up the secure cloud database and backend admin screen. Staff starts using it to manage live orders and catalogue without changing anything for customers.
2️⃣ Step 2: Customer Order Tracking
Once the team is comfortable with the admin portal, activate customer accounts and live order tracking to reduce phone calls and build repeat buyers.
3️⃣ Step 3: Cold Store & Van Routes
As wholesale marketing expands, give partner cold stores their login and equip van drivers with their mobile delivery stop checklist.
4️⃣ Step 4: Cash Audit & HR Compliance
Introduce daily van cash reconciliation, LMRA visa reminders, and WPS payroll exports when administrative volume demands it.
Recommendation for Internal Discussion:

We suggest beginning with Step 1 (Connecting the Cloud Database & Backend Admin Portal). It requires zero downtime, costs virtually nothing to run on modern cloud tiers, and immediately gives our staff a clean, centralized workspace to manage daily orders and customer contacts.
